THE PROPOSED TEMPLATE IS ITSELF BROKEN. This bead recommends rewriting the ~40 reachable messages on the model of R/crossnobis.R:230-232, the only message in the package containing runnable code. I executed that advice and it fails twice - the suggested call omits a required argument, and the object it produces is rejected by the function that suggested it. Detail and reproduction on bd-01KZYJ4XKQ8ZCNYHT9BHMD3W9E.

This does not change the recommendation on this bead, which is that messages should name a requirement, a reason, and a runnable fix. It changes the sequencing: fix the exemplar before copying its shape 40 times, and whatever process is used to generate the rewritten messages must EXECUTE the suggested code, not merely read well. A message containing code that does not run is worse than one containing no code, because it carries more authority.
